_doc: Operator-maintained registry: provider/account -> MCP server definition. connect.mjs reads profile.accounts and writes the box's .mcp.json from these. Creds come from host env (${VAR}); never commit secrets. Microsoft is concrete (research-verified 2026-06-22); google + todoist are placeholders — replace the command with YOUR actual MCP invocation.

microsoft.name: ms365
auth_steps: operator (once): register ONE multi-tenant Entra app + publisher-verify (free, one-time, no CASA); delegated scopes Mail.Send + Mail.Read + Calendars.ReadWrite; set MS365_MCP_CLIENT_ID
client: click the consent link — owner-operator on own domain self-consents as admin; personal Outlook.com = one-click; employee of a managed tenant may need their IT admin

google.name: google
google.superseded: 2026-08-17: Google is NOT operator-provisioned. The member connects it themselves with their OWN OAuth client via the app's Connections wizard (docs/design-google-byo-connect.md); mcp-connect.mjs add-google writes the real server entry against the image-baked /opt/gws/bin/workspace-mcp. This registry entry stays only so profile.accounts provider:google is recognised — connect.mjs must SKIP writing a server for it.
auth_steps: member: Connections page -> Google -> Set up (guided; own client, Testing mode, weekly re-key)

todoist.name: todoist
auth_steps: client: paste their Todoist API token -> secrets; export TODOIST_API_TOKEN
FILL: set the real todoist MCP command in this registry
